statusDefinitions.package-component: Reusable Design System implementation exists in @design-system/components or an equivalent component package.
statusDefinitions.interactive-fixture: Documentation demo has local interaction behavior, but is not yet a reusable Design System implementation.
statusDefinitions.fixture-only: Documentation demo is primarily static visual markup.
statusDefinitions.pattern-candidate: Boundary is unresolved or likely belongs to patterns once replacement dependencies are proven.

select.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for one closed-choice value; Combobox covers editable select input separately.

combobox.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for one editable single-select field with local option filtering; global search, async query orchestration, and multi-select remain pattern or separate component work.

checkbox.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components; group orchestration remains outside the component.

switch.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for persistent on/off setting semantics.

radio-button.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components; Radio Group behavior remains pattern/component-candidate work.

text-area.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for native multiline input.

badge.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for compact status/count metadata.

chip.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for static, selected, and removable chip affordances.

tag.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for compact metadata and optional action semantics.

tabs.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for bounded tablist semantics; routed navigation remains a pattern concern.

tooltip.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for short non-interactive contextual help.

toast.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for non-blocking status/alert feedback with one optional action.

inline-validation.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for one field with validation copy; form submission remains a pattern concern.

progress-indicator.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for determinate and indeterminate progressbar semantics.

spinner.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for compact circular indeterminate loading states.

skeleton.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for loading structure with status semantics.

dialog.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for modal surface semantics; confirmation policy, irreversible action handling, and recovery flows remain pattern work.

menu.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for compact contextual menu semantics; command routing, permission checks, and high-risk actions remain pattern work.

drawer.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for side drawer surface semantics; edit lifecycle, validation, submit, and support handoff remain pattern work.

accordion.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for bounded disclosure sections; multi-step processs remain patterns.

empty-state.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for bounded empty-condition copy and one local action.

table.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for semantic comparable records; remote data, filtering, pagination, expansion, and row processs remain pattern work.

avatar.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for identity fallback, image, size, and presence signal.

slider.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for native range selection.

stepper.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for local linear progress; wizard orchestration remains a pattern concern.

list.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for bounded list rows; row orchestration remains a pattern concern.

kpi-tile.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for one compact metric; dashboard composition remains a pattern concern.

chart-panel.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for one compact read-only chart summary; legends, filters, and series controls remain pattern work.

station-pin.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for one map marker; clustering, routing, and viewport behavior remain pattern work.

route-summary.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for one route option summary; comparison and navigation flows remain pattern work.

code-input.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for visible one-time-code slots; verification, resend, and recovery remain auth pattern work.

phone-input.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for native tel input with country prefix; verification handoff remains pattern work.

card-number-input.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for one grouped card number with local Luhn validation; expiry, CVC, tokenization, ownership, and submission remain future component or pattern work.

date-picker.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for native single-date input; date range and scheduling processs remain pattern work.

segmented-control.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for local mutually exclusive mode switching.

popover.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for short contextual dialog content; multi-step decisions remain pattern work.

floating-action-button.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for local primary action affordance.

card-summary.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for one card identity/status summary; card lifecycle actions remain pattern work.

movement-row.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for one movement row; receipts, disputes, and support flows remain pattern work.

quick-action.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for one compact local action; confirmation and high-risk action flows remain pattern work.

biometric-prompt.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for a local biometric prompt; authentication recovery, fallback routing, and risk escalation remain pattern work.

breadcrumbs.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for hierarchical navigation breadcrumbs.

pagination.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for bounded numbered pagination navigation.

audit-event.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for one audit event; timeline/filtering remains a pattern concern.

error-panel.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for bounded warning/error recovery surface.

tree-view.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for bounded tree semantics; permission editors, drag/drop, and multi-pane hierarchy processs remain pattern work.

motion-boundary.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for one bounded motion region; page choreography, route transitions, and animation storytelling remain foundation or pattern work.

animated-moment.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for one bounded animation moment; onboarding, education, campaign, and multi-step animation sequences remain pattern work.

card-expiry-input.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for one MM/YY card expiry with local month and expired-date validation; card number, CVC, tokenization, ownership, and submission remain future component or pattern work.

card-security-code-input.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for one card security code with local length validation and optional reveal; card number, expiry, tokenization, ownership, and submission remain future component or pattern work.

country-selector.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for reusable country and calling-code selection; Phone Input consumes this component instead of owning country selector behavior.

date-range-picker.notes: Factory and contract exist in @design-system/components for one bounded start/end date range; reporting sync, comparisons, URL persistence, and data refresh remain pattern concerns.
